reference_root_history.note: Original freeze location. The checkout was later moved to /home/ee/tb-ref/terminal-bench, which left this field pointing at a path that no longer exists. Two tools resolve the reference from it -- audit_independence_stream.py when --reference-root is omitted, and freeze_reference.py, whose default was separately hardcoded to the same dead path and now derives from this field instead. Both failed with a missing-path error, which is fail-closed behaviour and the right instinct but the wrong outcome for a moved checkout.

An intermediate correction that pointed at the repository root rather than the original-tasks subdirectory this field is documented to hold (freeze_reference.py writes it as tasks_root). It satisfied the audit, which accepts either form, but not freeze_reference.py --verify, which appends original-tasks itself. Corrected to the subdirectory form.
